payload.reason: The evidence indicates that analyzing self-attention functions in the last layer of the BERT model is justified due to the stability and strength of correlations with human attention, which do not significantly change with fine-tuning. Additionally, the last layer's attention flows provide better predictive performance compared to earlier layers.

claims.text: The last layer of BERT shows stable correlations with human attention that do not significantly change with fine-tuning.
Attention flows from the last layer provide stronger correlations for tasks compared to means over BERT attentions across the last layer.
